WITH siparis_tutarlar AS (
    SELECT 
        m.sehir,
        s.id as siparis_id,
        SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) as tutar,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.sehir ORDER BY SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat)) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY m.sehir) as toplam_siparis
    FROM siparisler s
    JOIN musteriler m ON s.musteri_id = m.id
    JOIN siparis_kalemleri sk ON s.id = sk.siparis_id
    GROUP BY m.sehir, s.id
),
medyan_hesapla AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        toplam_siparis as siparis_sayisi,
        tutar as medyan
    FROM siparis_tutarlar
    WHERE rn IN ((toplam_siparis + 1) / 2.0, toplam_siparis / 2.0 + 1)
),
medyan_ortalama AS (
    SELECT 
        sehir,
        AVG(medyan) as medyan
    FROM medyan_hesapla
    GROUP BY sehir
)
SELECT 
    mh.sehir,
    mt.siparis_sayisi,
    ROUND(mh.medyan, 2) as medyan
FROM medyan_ortalama mh
JOIN siparis_tutarlar mt ON mh.sehir = mt.sehir AND mt.toplam_siparis >= 2
WHERE mt.toplam_siparis >= 2
ORDER BY mh.medyan DESC, mh.sehir ASC;
